errors.PIN_RETRY_LATER: Too many wrong PINs. Wait a little and try again: after five wrong tries every next one waits longer (30 s, 1 min, 5 min, 15 min). The wait does not protect a copied file; level 3 does.
errors.PIN_FORMAT: A new PIN must be at least 6 digits, digits only
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_WEAK: For level 3 the password must be at least 16 characters and not weak
errors.SECURITY_DOWNGRADE_REFUSED: This would lower the vault's protection. The vault keeps crypto data, so it stays at level 3
errors.SYNC_SECURITY_LEVEL_REQUIRED: “{name}” or this device is below level 3: crypto data syncs only between devices at level 3. Go to level 3 on both.
securityRaise.title: Move to level 3
securityRaise.warning.lead: Exchange API keys work only at level 3. The vault is at level {level} now.
securityRaise.warning.passwordPin: Sign-in with a password of 16 characters or more instead of a PIN
securityRaise.warning.passwordPlain: Sign-in with a password of 16 characters or more
securityRaise.warning.reencrypt: The vault is re-encrypted with stronger parameters
securityRaise.warning.autolock: Autolock is required while the device holds API keys
securityRaise.warning.downgrade: The level can be lowered only after the keys and crypto data are erased
securityRaise.restart.title: Starting again
securityRaise.restart.text: The last move was not finished, the vault did not change. Enter the passwords again.
securityRaise.password.tooShort: Too short: at least 16 characters needed
securityRaise.password.tooWeak: Too simple: add length and different kinds of characters
securityRaise.backup.lead: Before re-encrypting we save a copy of the vault. Without it the move does not start.
securityRaise.backup.where: The copy is saved next to the vault file and opens with the current PIN. It stays there after the move; you delete it yourself.
securityRaise.backup.wherePlain: The copy is saved next to the vault file. It stays there after the move; you delete it yourself.
securityRaise.run.lead: Do not close the app, it takes less than a minute.
securityRaise.failure.title: The move did not finish
securityRaise.failure.text: The vault stays at level {level}, the data is in place. The backup is kept. You can try again.
securityRaise.failure.textBackup: The backup was not written, so the vault did not change. Check free space and access, then try again.
securityRaise.failure.stage.verify: Checking by reopening did not pass
securityRaise.done.title: Level 3 is on
securityRaise.done.text: The vault is re-encrypted and opened with the new password.
securityRaise.done.exchanges: Exchanges and API keys are available now
securityRaise.done.backupNext: Backup: next to the vault file
securityRaise.done.reenter: Enter the Bybit key again: it is not kept in memory during re-encryption
securityRaise.interrupt.title: Stop the move?
securityRaise.interrupt.text: The vault stays at the current level, the backup is kept. A Bybit key cannot be connected until the move is finished.
securityRaise.interrupted.title: The move to level 3 is not finished
securityRaise.interrupted.text: The vault stays at the current level, the data did not change. Bybit works after the move.
securityLevel.title: Protection level
securityLevel.loadFailed: Could not load the protection settings
securityLevel.loadFailedHint: The vault is open and protected as before. Try again.
securityLevel.text.ledger: No encryption, for ordinary money accounting.
securityLevel.text.pin: Protects against casual access to the app. A PIN does not protect against theft of the file.
securityLevel.text.crypto: A strong password, hardened encryption, exchange keys only on this device.
securityLevel.howTo: Level 3 starts when you connect the Bybit exchange. There is no separate switch.
securityLevel.noDowngrade.title: The level cannot be lowered
securityLevel.noDowngrade.text: API keys are stored on this device. You can go back to level 1 or 2 only after the keys and crypto data are erased, with a mandatory backup. Erasing arrives in a later update.
